intro: Professionals and everyday users convert us short tons (ton (US)) to metric tons (t) when working across us_customary and metric standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One us short ton equals 0.907185 metric tons, while 1 metric ton (tonne / megagram) equals 1.102311 us short tons. Whether you are verifying mass & weight specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Short Ton (US) vs. Metric Tonne (t) vs. Long Ton (UK)
items: Three distinct units are called a "ton": the US Short Ton equals 2,000 lbs (907.185 kg), the Metric Tonne (t) equals 1,000 kg (2,204.62 lbs), and the British Imperial Long Ton equals 2,240 lbs (1,016.05 kg).
Confusing US short tons with metric tonnes introduces a 10.2% freight weight error on international bills of lading.

faqs.question: How many metric tons (t) are in 1 us short ton (ton (US))?
faqs.answer: There are 0.90718474 metric tons (t) in 1 us short ton (ton (US)), which rounds to 0.9072 t for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 metric ton (tonne / megagram) equals 1.102311 us short tons.

faqs.question: How do I convert us short tons to metric tons (ton (US) to t)?
faqs.answer: To convert us short tons to metric tons, use the formula: t = ton (US) × 0.90718474. For example, converting 10 ton (US) gives 9.0718 t.

faqs.question: What is 10 us short tons in metric tons?
faqs.answer: 10 us short tons (ton (US)) equals exactly 9.0718 metric tons (t) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
